Definition: A bounded unit of selectable work ordered by the active completion plan within a stated write scope.
The parent persona/agent responsible for integration, validation, coordination updates, CHANGE handoff, and final summary.
An optional, bounded subagent used when subscopes are separable and write scopes disjoint; its outputs are draft evidence until integrated.
The closeout agent that performs final Git/file-state review and commits and pushes validated work.
The mapping of governance surfaces to what each owns and its boundary.
A non-governing documentation surface recording landed planning, validation, release, and workflow tranches.
The active non-governing tranche-selection surface that orders work without changing product requirements or release posture.
The current phase whose dominant question is what runtime capability should become real next.
A human-governed decision or stop point that agents prepare packets for but do not decide.
The desktop harness and bundled agent operating system that is the product.
Dependency/SCC discovery evidence that informs blocker analysis without replacing decomposition truth.
Release-quality gate selection by change family; gate evidence is not release publication authorization.
